name: Dice Showdown
detailed_description:
Welcome to Dice Showdown, a world where tense turn-based combat perfectly blends with the unpredictable thrill of Roguelike adventure! Here, luck is the foundation, but strategy is the crown. You will play as Rod, the Dicemancer, embarking on a quest to save the world by wielding the power of dice through wisdom against cunning and ever-changing foes!

Every expedition is a fresh challenge: randomly generated skills, diverse enemies encountered, and mysterious Artifacts discovered will all shape your unique combat style. Face a series of bizarre and fantastical opponents – from treacherous thieves and hollow skeletons to bloodthirsty Vampire Counts and strangely peculiar werewolves...

Core Gameplay:

Combat revolves around DICE! Actions for both you and your enemies hinge on the roll of the dice. But fear not, this isn't pure chance! Before battle begins, you can scout enemy skills and use your own collected skills to strategically modify the upcoming dice rolls for both sides. Will you bolster your own strength or cripple your foe? Every choice is critical.

Crucially, the powerful Artifacts discovered during your foray – only by successfully extracting can you bring them back safely for your next vital journey! Within the Safehouse, you can even combine existing Artifacts into more potent and unique gear. Forge mighty combinations of skills and Artifacts, master the dice and your extraction timing with wisdom, and carve your path to survival in this dice-dominated world!

Can you save the world? The fate of the world rests in your hands!

Key Features:

  • Dice-Driven Combat & Strategic Depth: Attacks, skill activations – everything hinges on dice rolls, delivering unique tension. Scout enemies and use your skills to crucially modify rolls, turning luck into tactical mastery.

  • Thrilling Loot-Combat-Extract Loop:

    • Explore a world rife with opportunity and peril to discover mysterious Artifacts.

    • Fight and outmaneuver enemies using strategy.

    • Successfully Extract to retain and take all Artifacts found on your run!

    • ⚠️ Extraction Failure means losing ALL unprotected Artifacts – the Secure Container is your lifeline to protect crucial equipped gear.

  • Artifact Synthesis & Progression: Within the Safehouse, combine Artifacts brought back from your runs into more powerful and unique equipment, constantly enhancing your capabilities.

  • Roguelike Adventure: Every run is unique! Randomly generated skills, enemies, events, Artifacts, and extraction points ensure each adventure is fresh, challenging, and filled with tense extraction decisions.

  • Craft Your Unique Build: Collect a vast array of skills and Artifacts during your adventures. Mix and match them freely to forge your own distinct combat style.

  • Face Diverse Foes: Battle cunning thieves, eerie skeletons, formidable Vampire Counts, enigmatic werewolves, and more – each requiring tailored tactics to overcome.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible graphics card, integrated graphics
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible graphics card, integrated graphics
